Hardening of the admin HTTP routes; removed an unused chat endpoint.

## Server

### Changed
- The admin HTTP API checks a request's signature before it stores the body. Bodies up to 64 KB work as before. A larger body, such as a snapshot upload, now sends its SHA-256 in `X-Solarpunk-Content-Sha256`; without it the server answers `428`, and a body of unknown length without it gets `411`. One upload runs at a time. See `docs/ADMIN.md`.
- Public reads (`/api/v1/health`, `/api/v1/players`, `/api/v1/manifest`, the MOTD and the map page) have their own request slots, separate from the signed routes.
- `GET /api/v1/chat/recent` now needs the admin signature, like the other admin routes. `GET /api/v1/chat/motd` stays public.

### Removed
- `POST /api/v1/chat/player`, which nothing used. Admin messages still go out through RCON `say`/`announce` and the signed `POST /api/v1/chat/say`.

Players need nothing installed: in Solarpunk choose Multiplayer, Join session, Enter Code, and type the server's 5-letter code.
